title: Grammar Warm-Up
subtitle: Explanation text feature or not? Sort each item into the correct column.

cards.label: Item 1
lines: Written in the past tense
“He crept through the shadows”
Explanation text feature?
Yes or No?

cards.label: Item 2
lines: Causal connective
“As a result, the cat can
escape undetected.”
Explanation text feature?
Yes or No?

cards.label: Item 3
lines: Rhetorical question as a hook
“Have you ever wondered how
a cat survives the city?”
Explanation text feature?
Yes or No?

title: The rhetorical question.
lines: “Have you ever imagined leaving the safety of your home
and stepping into the city for the very first time?”
Why does the writer start with a question?
•  It pulls the reader in immediately.
•  It makes the reader think from a cat’s point of view.
•  It sets up the problem the text will explain how to solve.
You do not answer it straight away.
You make the reader want to read on.

title: Subheadings and register.
lines: Each skill section has a one-word subheading.
What does the subheading do?
•  It tells the reader exactly what the section is about.
•  It makes the text easy to navigate.
What is the register of the writing?
•  Formal but not cold.
•  Third person — not ‘you should’ (that is instructions), not ‘I did’ (that is recount).
•  Present tense throughout.
Find a sentence in the model text that shows this clearly.

title: How the connectives work.
lines: Find these connectives in the model text:
therefore    •  as a result    •  due to
since    •  in that event    •  when this happens
For each one, ask:
1.  What cause does it follow?
2.  What effect does it introduce?
Notice: they do not all go in the same position in the sentence.
Some start the sentence. Some appear in the middle.
That variety is what makes the writing feel controlled, not mechanical.
With your partner, annotate your copy of the model text.
Use three different colours or symbols:
●  Mark the rhetorical question and introduction
●  Mark every subheading
●  Underline every causal connective you find
Then complete the boxing-up grid together for the
Open Mind and Awareness sections.
What goes in each box?
What does the skill is / how it works / what happens as a result?
